crops.text: May choose to eat Healing Items as if it were a [machine], or not a [machine].Healing can go above its max HP.All non-healing items directly used on this creature must be eaten as healing items that heal either (3x Item Star Level) or (DMG + All Status Effect Star Levels * 2) HP instead of their normal effect (whichever is larger).If negated reactively to eating, item is optionally not used.
